requests.name: act_shake_numb_hand_bed
requests.why: 손목터널증후군 훅('새벽마다 손끝이 찌릿하게 저려서 손을 탈탈 털며 깨신 적')과 '특히 잘 때는 손목을 굽힌 채 … 밤에 더 눌리고 저려서 깨요' 칸의 행위. 누워 있다 일어나 앉아 한 손을 탈탈 턴다 — act_rub_hands(두 손 비비기)로는 '털며 깬다'가 안 보인다. (2026-10-04 1차 미드저니는 4장 모두 앉아서 턱 괴는 '생각하는 사람' 자세로 나와, '잘 때 손목을 굽힌 채'와 '깨서 턴다'가 안 보여 다시 뽑는다 — 누운 상반신 클로즈업으로 세로 화면을 채운다) (2026-10-06 1차 Flow는 주먹을 쥐었다 폈다 하고 새끼손가락까지 켜져 반려 — _v1 보관. 털기를 '손목에서 축 늘어진 손을 물 털듯 위아래로 빠르게'로 구체화하고 쥐기·펴기를 직접 금지)
requests.midjourney: Medical holographic visualization of a single translucent glass-like human figure, every structure rendered in the same soft pale cyan glow, dark empty slate blue-grey void, cinematic soft rim lighting, vertical 9:16 portrait frame, smooth featureless face, The figure lies asleep on its side in a bed, seen from slightly above, the head resting on a plain flat pillow and a thin plain blanket of the same translucent cyan glass pulled up to the waist, one hand tucked under the chin with the wrist bent sharply forward and curled tight, framed from the top of the head down to the waist so the sleeping head, the shoulder and the curled hand fill the vertical frame. The bones of the hand and wrist and the fine nerves of the forearm are visible through the glass shell. --ar 9:16 --no text, letters, numbers, labels, arrows, watermark, logo, UI, interface, amber, orange, red, blood colour, opaque skin, clothing, hair, facial features, brand marks, other people, duplicated limbs, sitting, seated, standing, chair, open eyes
requests.flow: One continuous shot in a single unbroken scene with no scene cuts. 0-1.5s: from the very first frame the figure lying face down on the pillow jolts awake and pushes up onto one elbow, lifting the curled right hand away from under the chin, while the camera rushes in toward that hand. 1.5-4.5s: the figure shakes the right hand hard and fast from the wrist, the whole hand flapping loosely up and down five or six times like flicking water off it, the fingers limp, loose and blurred with motion. The hand never makes a fist and the fingers never open and close — it is a fast, floppy wrist shake. While it shakes, only the thumb, the index finger, the middle finger and the thumb-side half of the ring finger glow amber; the little finger stays clearly pale cyan and unlit the whole time. 4.5-6s: the camera pushes in tight on the still-shaking hand, those three and a half fingers glowing intense amber until the very last frame while the little finger, every other bone and the glass skin stay soft pale cyan. The body stays translucent glass with all organs and bones visible inside throughout; the face stays smooth and featureless, the dark slate blue-grey void stays empty. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame. No fist clenching, no finger curling, no counting on fingers, no waving hello. Low synth hum with the quick soft whoosh of the hand flapping, no music, no dialogue.
